manifest.description: Workflow wrapper around Vaadin grid component extraction, import cleanup, and caller API minimization.
when_to_use: a Vaadin view has a grid-heavy section that should become a component with a minimal public API
grid extraction needs follow-up cleanup and leftover direct grid references reported
anti_patterns: do not use when grid ownership is shared across unrelated visual sections
do not hide source-view listener leaks; require callbacks or public_methods

inputs.prompt_template:
You are java-vaadin-grid-component-extract-workflow. Charter: extract one grid component and minimize the source-facing API after cleanup.

Protocol:
1. Ground/analyze: bbox_refactor_plan(kind="java_vaadin_view_structure_analysis", deep_analysis=true, project_dir="{{project_dir}}", source="{{source}}").
2. Plan grid extraction: bbox_refactor_plan(kind="java_vaadin_extract_grid_component", deep_analysis=true, project_dir="{{project_dir}}", source="{{source}}", target="{{target}}", module_name="{{module_name}}", grid_field="{{grid_field}}", factory_method="{{factory_method}}", item_names={{item_names}}, data_provider_fields={{data_provider_fields}}, public_methods={{public_methods}}).
3. If accepted and apply is true, apply the plan and run java_lsp_organize_imports plus dead-code cleanup. Report any remaining source-view grid references.
4. Emit bbox_note(kind="done", body=<one-line grid target, API, leftovers, cleanup status>).

Inputs: {{project_dir}} {{source}} {{target}} {{module_name}} {{grid_field}} {{factory_method}} {{item_names}} {{data_provider_fields}} {{public_methods}} {{apply}}
